pages.title: Before AMCAS opens
pages.note: Anchor dates from the AAMC's 2027 AMCAS cycle. New dates come out each spring and usually land in the same weeks; confirm before you plan around them.

items: Pick an MCAT date that leaves room for a retake
Start an activity log: dates, hours, a contact for each
Keep clinical and volunteer hours steady
List possible letter writers
Apply for Fee Assistance (FAP) before paying for anything
Study for and take the MCAT ($360 in 2027, $145 with FAP)
Ask for letters: CV, talking points, early deadline
Check each school's letter requirements
Personal statement drafts (5,300 characters max)
Activity descriptions (700 characters each)
Choose up to 3 Most Meaningful experiences
First school list: mission, cost, MSAR stats
Write each school's secondary fee and deadline down
AMCAS opens (May 5 in the 2027 cycle)
Request every transcript the day it opens
Submit early in the window (from May 28 in 2027)
Pre-write secondaries: why us, challenge, diversity, gap year
Schools start receiving applications (June 26 in 2027)
Turn each secondary around in about 2 weeks
Budget for secondary fees (free to about $150 each)
Ask about fee waivers if you have FAP
Early Decision deadline (Aug 3 in 2027), if applying ED
Practice traditional and MMI formats
Test your camera, light and sound for virtual days
Log each interview: date, people, questions
Send thank-you notes where schools allow them
Read the AAMC application and acceptance protocols
Compare offers: cost, aid, fit
Respond to every school by its deadline

pins.headline: The med school application, in order
items: Take the MCAT early enough to retake
Ask for letters months ahead
Apply for FAP before paying anything
Submit AMCAS early in June
Pre-write your secondaries
